detailed_description: JSON Repair fixes common malformed JSON problems that appear when examples come from JavaScript, logs, or hand-edited config files. It can remove comments, quote bare object keys, convert single-quoted strings, and drop trailing commas, then prints formatted JSON when the result parses successfully. Use it as a quick local cleanup step before pasting data into an API client, validator, or config file.
